text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My first three years with Neo Universe ended with respectable results. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—September. Invited by Neo Universe,
I decided to set out on a little journey.
Our destination is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Neo Universe
really wanted to... come to this place.
choice_data_list: Why are you at the racetrack?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at Sapporo Racecourse.
It was a place I had never had a deep connection with until now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I'm curious about, though,
is the reason you wanted to come here...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The 'TIFY' that wanted to come here today,
no matter what, was—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Because it is the “final destination.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Neo Universe of another universe...
"departed"... right here.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Right after finding out she couldn't run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It was here that I said "goodbye."
To all the people of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Journeys are—"irreversible."
Because once you leave, you can never truly come back.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe! Great job out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, thank you!
Make sure to get plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe was loved...
and 'expected' of."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"There is no 'Northern Cross' inside Neo Universe.
She can align her light with any star..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There was... a continuation after the end.
I didn't want to see it, which is why it was a 'starlight shadow.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The story of what happened to the Neo Universe of another universe... afterward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a painful story to tell, but the fact that
she shared it anyway was surely a sign of trust.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
After the "Monument" was erected,
Neo Universe and "you"
could share nothing together ever again.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even amidst all of that, though...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"There was just one thing.
A 'spectrum' that spilled
from the 'diffuse nebula'..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Together with the light left behind by Neo Universe, "you"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Departed for the other side of the ocean.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
She went and "accomplished" it.
And with the "flag" raised high in her hand...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"To the 'humans' grieving the trembling of the planet...
Grant them... 'BREX'..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't just sadness. Even if
it wasn't with Neo Universe..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "You" rode the current of Neo Universe and showed me "INZY".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I only had a vague idea...
But as long as I understood one thing, that's enough."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That the other universe held not only tragedy...
but wonderful memories, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, that story was—
choice_data_list: I'll keep this close to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “Store” it... in my chest?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because that's a different story.
Yeah, because it's a different story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is a story entirely separate
from the days the two of them were about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is... something for someone, somewhere,
to unravel once again.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative.
That is correct, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In this universe, Neo Universe
can keep on running forever. That is why...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to "partake."
...With Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This time, starting to tick once more.
Tap tap, dash dash...
